probe_notes: P2/P3/P5 correctly localised 2-3 distinct foods (service detect matched ground truth). P2_same_idli_twice shows same-class multiple instances are kept (IoU < 0.6). P4_four_distinct (1x4 row of four foods) produced 0 service boxes at the built-in 0.25 conf threshold; raw inference at conf=0.1 recovers only 3 weak boxes (conf ~0.175-0.178) and misses the samosa tile. Interpretation: multi-object recall degrades in crowded compositions; consistent with a detector trained on single-food images.
